pages.title: HLD fundamentals
pages.blurb: Scaling, caching, databases, partitioning, queues, CAP, estimation, and the 45-minute delivery framework.

pages.title: LLD fundamentals
pages.blurb: OOP, SOLID, the 12 patterns that cover most LLD rounds, concurrency in C++, and how to run a machine-coding round.

pages.title: URL Shortener
pages.blurb: Bitly: short codes, 100:1 reads, base62, counters vs hashing, redirects at the edge.

pages.title: Rate Limiter
pages.blurb: Token bucket, sliding windows, Redis with Lua, where to put the limiter, and failing open.

pages.title: LRU Cache and Distributed Cache
pages.blurb: From a thread-safe O(1) LRU in C++ to a Redis-like cluster with hashing, replication and hot keys.

pages.title: Parking Lot
pages.blurb: The classic LLD opener: spots, tickets, pricing strategies, and making allocation thread-safe.

pages.title: Vending Machine
pages.blurb: The State pattern done properly: idle, has-money, dispensing, change-making and refunds.

pages.title: Elevator System
pages.blurb: Requests, dispatcher strategies (SCAN/LOOK), per-car state machines, and a controller thread.

pages.title: Notification System
pages.blurb: Email, SMS and push at scale: queues per channel, retries, dedup, preferences and templates.

pages.title: Logging Framework
pages.blurb: A log4j-style library: levels, appenders, formatters, async writing, and the pipeline it feeds.

pages.title: Pub-Sub and Message Queue
pages.blurb: In-memory pub-sub in C++, then Kafka: partitions, consumer groups, offsets and delivery guarantees.

pages.title: File System
pages.blurb: Composite tree of files and directories, path resolution, permissions, then Dropbox-style sync.

pages.title: Splitwise
pages.blurb: Expenses, split strategies, balance sheets, and simplifying debts with a greedy heap.

pages.title: BookMyShow / Ticketmaster
pages.blurb: Seat holds with TTL, no double booking, virtual waiting rooms for hot shows, and search.

pages.title: WhatsApp / Chat
pages.blurb: Persistent connections, delivery receipts, offline inboxes, groups, presence and ordering.

pages.title: News Feed
pages.blurb: Fan-out on write vs read, the celebrity problem, feed caches and ranking.

pages.title: YouTube / Video Streaming
pages.blurb: Resumable uploads, a transcoding DAG, adaptive bitrate streaming and CDN economics.

pages.title: Uber / Ride Hailing
pages.blurb: Location ingestion, geohash/quadtree search, matching without double-assigning drivers.

pages.title: Payment System / Digital Wallet
pages.blurb: Idempotency keys, double-entry ledgers, payment state machines, PSP callbacks and reconciliation.

pages.title: Top K / Leaderboard
pages.blurb: Heavy hitters over time windows: exact vs count-min sketch, Flink aggregation, Redis sorted sets.

pages.title: Web Crawler
pages.blurb: Frontier queues, politeness per domain, dedup with Bloom filters and hashes, fault tolerance.

pages.title: Chess and Snake & Ladder
pages.blurb: Machine-coding round favourites: board, pieces, move validation, turns and game state.

pages.title: Computer Networks
pages.blurb: OSI vs TCP/IP, TCP internals, HTTP versions, DNS, TLS, subnetting, and what happens when you type a URL.

pages.title: Operating Systems
pages.blurb: Processes, threads, scheduling, synchronization, deadlocks, memory management and file systems.

pages.title: DBMS and SQL
pages.blurb: ER and normalization, transactions and isolation, B+ tree indexes, and SQL patterns that OAs test.

pages.title: OOP in C++
pages.blurb: Pillars with C++ examples, vtables, constructors, rule of 3/5, smart pointers and casting.

pages.title: React
pages.blurb: Rendering model, hooks in depth, state management, performance, and the questions frontend rounds ask.

pages.title: FastAPI and Backend
pages.blurb: Async Python, Pydantic, dependencies, JWT auth, SQLAlchemy sessions, testing and deployment.
